summary: The launcher protected-path refusal now routes through targetTouchesProtectedV1, which applies the family-aware generic predicate for generic configurations and preserves the literal predicate for named policies. The added test covers nested env files on a generic target while retaining the existing self-target cases.

evidence: ops/hosted-autonomy-spent-delivery.ts imports targetTouchesProtectedV1 and calls it in touchesTargetProtected, used by both the plain merge-time protectedPathRefusal and the carried merge gate.
targetTouchesProtectedV1 calls isGenericTargetProtectedPathV1 for generic command ids and touchesProtected otherwise, so nested env files are now refused for generic targets.
tests/host/hosted-autonomy-protected-merge_test.ts adds generic-target cases covering root, nested, and escaped env paths plus a non-protected env.example control.
